sql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(t.average_rating), 2) AS avg_rating
FROM titles t
WHERE t.title_type = 'movie'
  AND t.start_year BETWEEN 1990 AND 1999
  AND t.start_year IS NOT NULL
  AND t.average_rating IS NOT NULL
summary: 共发现 0 个性能问题。SQL 已经是优化状态：单表聚合查询，明确指定了聚合列（非 SELECT *），WHERE 条件精确过滤了类型、年份和 NULL 值，返回单行聚合结果无需 LIMIT。无需优化。
